editor.premise: A quiet cottage morning unfolds through misty walks, gathered flowers, breakfast and firelight, before revealing how the day was filmed.

chapters.name: Waking up
chapters.purpose: Move from bed to outdoors and establish the morning routine.

chapters.name: Morning walk
chapters.purpose: Build an unhurried atmosphere through walking, wildlife and changing light.

chapters.name: Gathering flowers
chapters.purpose: Turn quick gathering actions into a gift and an interior centerpiece.

chapters.name: Making breakfast
chapters.purpose: Follow preparation through eating, then let the morning breathe.

chapters.name: Resting indoors
chapters.purpose: Lower the energy after breakfast and motivate the need for warmth.

chapters.name: Building a fire
chapters.purpose: Connect outdoor wood preparation to the reward of indoor warmth.

chapters.name: Behind the camera
chapters.purpose: Pivot from the finished day into an explanation of filming equipment.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered diary sentences continue across cuts; occasional extra lines clarify details. Persistent corner equipment labels sit separately from the narrative.

editor.notes: Keep walking shots mostly two to three seconds. Accelerate repetitive gathering and cooking with short inserts and jump cuts; hold shared meals longer. Carry sentences across cuts, and use landscape breaths between tasks rather than explaining every transition.
